AK
AK (Kalashnikov assault rifle) — one of the later modifications of the machine gun, but still with a milled receiver, adopted for service in the USSR in 1949.
AKS
AKS — (Kalashnikov assault rifle Folding)
AKM
АКМ (Avtomat Kalashnikova modernizirovannyy) modernized Kalashnikov assault rifle — assault rifle adopted by the USSR Armed Forces in 1959 to replace the AK assault rifle.
AKMS
AKMS (Avtomat Kalashnikova modernizirovannyy skladnoy) modernized folding Kalashnikov assault rifle.
АKS
АKS — Avtomat Kalashnikova skladnoy
AK-74
AK-74 — 5.45 mm assault rifle, developed in 1970 by Soviet designer M. T. Kalashnikov and adopted by the USSR armed forces in 1974.
Type-88-2
Type-88-2 — A North Korean copy of the AK-74, also known as Type 98 \ Type 88. This version is equipped with a screw magazine, which differs significantly from the standard AK-74 mag, which is why it does not have any compatibility with the original.
 %c[d_red]It only works correctly with the magazines function.
AK-101
AK-101 — export version of the AK-74M assault rifle, differing in the use of 5.56x45 mm cartridges (NATO standard SS109).
AK-103
AK-103 — export version of the AK-74M assault rifle, differing in the use of 7.62x39 mm cartridges (Soviet cartridge of the 1943 model).
AKS-74
AKS-74 — ariant of the AK-74 with a left-folding metal frame buttstock. Designed for use in airborne troops.
PP «Bizon»
PP-19 «Bizon» — submachine gun model 19, developed in 1993 by V. M. Kalashnikov (son of designer M. T. Kalashnikov) and Alexei Dragunov (son of E. F. Dragunov).
PP «Vityaz»
PP-19-01 «Vityaz» — submachine gun developed in 2004 by the Izhmash company. Based, depending on the version, on the AKS-74U (version 10) or on the AK-105 (version 20).
Saiga-12
Saiga-12 — 12-gauge self-loading shotgun manufactured at the Izhevsk Machine-Building Plant based on the Kalashnikov assault rifle and designed for commercial and amateur hunting of small and medium-sized game and birds in areas with any climatic conditions.
Saiga-308
Saiga-308 is a self-loading carbine Saiga 308 chambered for the 308 Win cartridge. developed on the basis of the Kalashnikov AK74M assault rifle and has a reinforced design for the use of powerful hunting ammunition.
Ots-12 «Tiss»
Ots-12 «Tiss» — assault rifle developed at the Tula Central Design Bureau for Sports and Hunting Weapons (TsKIB SOO) based on the AKS74U. The key difference is the use of special subsonic 9x39 mm cartridges.
AK-9
AK-9 — shortened assault rifle created by IzhMash designers based on the AK-74M, chambered for special subsonic cartridges 9x39 mm.
AS «Val»
Avtomat Spetsial'nyy (the special assault rifle) “Val” is a silent assault rifle developed at the Klimov TsNIITochmash by designers P. Serdyukov and V. Krasnikov in the second half of the 1980s on the basis of the “VSS” silent sniper rifle.
SR-3 «Vihr»
SR-3 «Vihr» — compact machine, developed on the basis of the silent machine AS "Val".
VSS «Vintorez»
Vintovka Snayperskaya Spetsial'naya (Special Sniper Rifle) “Vintorez” is a silent sniper rifle for special forces. The name "Vintorez" remained in common use after its use in design documentation.
Vepr-12 «Molot»
Vepr-12 «Molot» — 12-gauge smooth-bore self-loading shotgun, developed based on the design of the Kalashnikov light machine gun.
PP «Gepard»
PP «Gepard» — submachine gun developed in 1995 by Gennady Vasilyevich Sitov and Alexander Vyacheslavovich Shevchenko on their own initiative. It was first presented to the public in 1997.
ВПО-123
The Boar 7.62x54R (VPO-123) is a hunting self–loading carbine designed for hunting medium and large animals on a commercial or amateur scale.
